name: Resume Agent
description: Resumes a suspended agent, clearing any error and setting status to SLEEPING. If the agent has pending work (tasks or inbox messages), it will be woken immediately.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

autoWake.description: If true (default), immediately start the agent if it has pending work or a wake was requested while suspended. Set to false to resume into SLEEPING without starting.
